source.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate one original reference photograph for an AI photo-to-art skill demonstration. Landscape 3:2 composition, polished but natural travel editorial photography. A small quiet coastal reading terrace in a fictional Mediterranean-inspired seaside town at late afternoon. On the left third a tall muted coral red arched wooden doorway in a pale warm limestone wall; center foreground a small round teal bistro table with exactly one cream ceramic coffee cup and one closed ochre-yellow book, no lettering; on the right foreground one ginger cat sits in side profile looking left toward the table, tail curled beside its paws; behind the cat a low cream parapet overlooks a calm turquoise sea and a single tiny white sailboat near the right horizon. A few bougainvillea leaves with sparse magenta flowers hang from the upper left. Keep the cat, table and door clearly separated, with readable silhouettes and realistic proportions. Eye-level view, 45mm lens, soft slanting sun from upper left, subtle natural textures. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no collage, no montage. Full bleed one continuous photograph. This image is synthetic demonstration material; it should look like a convincing original travel photograph.
